paragraphs: Professional Plumbing & Heating Experts for over 30 years in Leeds, West Yorkshire
B.S Plumbing and Heating offer a wide range of services, from installing new boilers to landlord certificates, and we are sure to help you with your gas or plumbing needs.
From re-routing or replacing old pipe work or gas safety checks to installing a complex under-floor central heating system we take on all jobs, large or small.
Do you need a new gas boiler? BS Plumbing and Heating in Yorkshire can help. We can offer help and advice on the type of boiler that you need to suit your property and your budget.
B.S Plumbing and Heating will ensure that these checks are done professionally by Gas Safe registered tradesmen, ensuring your home has had all the appropriate gas safety checks.
B.S Plumbing and Heating supply a full service for landlord gas safety checks. We are a competitively priced British Standards registered company, and Gas Safe registered.
B.S. Plumbing and Heating can provide professional installations for your gas cooker, electric cooker, gas hob and oven and Gas or Electric Fires.
At B.S. Plumbing and Heating, we like to think we are second to none on our pipe work in your bathroom or kitchen and we work to a high standard for all our customers.
We are a family run business with over 30 years of experience in the plumbing industry and all our plumbers are Gas Safe registered.

Our company’s aim is to work for you, the deserving customer. We always endeavour to give you our best plumbing and heating service. We operate all around Leeds and West Yorkshire including Adel, Garforth, Kippax, Pudsey, Farnley, Gledhow and Roundhay and many more local areas.
